name: brand-reference-scout
description: Find Internet Archive footage that fits your brand and campaign brief, then choose it in a private two-up review.

interface.longDescription: Bring brand context, campaign examples and a concrete brief. Scout searches Internet Archive for the best visual matches, without imposing an era or vintage look, then opens a private review with selections and sourced exports. Stock footage is used only when explicitly requested.
defaultPrompt: Find B-roll for my campaign from my brand and previous work.
